segs.t: Most people only see the $2 million a month brand I run right now, but they do not see where it started.
I had an e-commerce brand for two years and did seven figures in revenue,
built it from scratch and then ended up losing it all overnight.
I had to restart from zero. No brand, no revenue, nothing but the knowledge I had built up over
the years and the resources I still had access to. So I ended up starting a supplement brand.
This time it was with systems and this brand now does $2 million a month every single month
consistently and it runs without me putting out fires every single day. Most of you watching
this are doing between 30k to 300k a month with e-commerce and on paper that looks good, but here's
the reality. You're not building a brand, you're building a store and you're the worker that's
working inside of that store. So basically you're going to be the fireman every single day jumping
between problems, testing new things, pushing harder and somehow you can seem to unlock scale.
Everything you try feels like it should work and then it doesn't and you do not even know why.
That feeling is not because you're not working hard enough but it's because you're working inside of
the wrong systems. What changed everything for me the second time around was not finding a better
product or a better market. It was actually building the systems that allow a brand to
scale without me needing to pull it together. The creative engine that produces winners
consistently or the retention strategies that turn a one-time purchase customer
into a returning customer that pays you every single month or the branding and positioning
that makes your customer feel like they actually found something that's specifically
built for them. That is the framework I now help other brand owners implement inside of their own
brands and it's what takes people from running a store to actually owning them to running a brand
that actually scales to seven figures a month. Follow me if you want to learn the real strategies
behind scaling a brand past 100k a month.
